var kh=.03,Ah=null,jh=null,Mh=null,Nh=0;function Ph(){if(Ah)return Ah;let e=window.AudioContext;if(!e)return null;Ah=new e;let t=Ah.createDynamicsCompressor();t.threshold.value=-18,t.ratio.value=6,t.connect(Ah.destination),jh=t,Mh=Ah.createBuffer(1,Math.floor(Ah.sampleRate*.03),Ah.sampleRate);let n=Mh.getChannelData(0);for(let e=0;e<n.length;e++)n[e]=Math.random()*2-1;let r=()=>{Ah?.resume(),window.removeEventListener(`pointerdown`,r),window.removeEventListener(`keydown`,r)};return window.addEventListener(`pointerdown`,r),window.addEventListener(`keydown`,r),Ah}function Fh(e,t=!1){let n=Ph();if(!n||!jh||!Mh)return;if(n.state!==`running`){!t&&navigator.userActivation?.isActive&&n.resume().then(()=>Fh(e,!0));return}let{volume:r,pan:i}=e,a=n.currentTime;if(a-Nh<kh)return;Nh=a;let o=1+(Math.random()-.5)*.12,s=n.createStereoPanner();s.pan.value=Math.max(-.8,Math.min(.8,i)),s.connect(jh);let c=n.createOscillator();c.type=`sine`,c.frequency.setValueAtTime(170*o,a),c.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(110*o,a+.04);let l=n.createGain();l.gain.setValueAtTime(1e-4,a),l.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.4*r,a+.004),l.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1e-4,a+.06),c.connect(l).connect(s);let u=n.createBufferSource();u.buffer=Mh,u.playbackRate.value=o;let d=n.createBiquadFilter();d.type=`lowpass`,d.frequency.value=1200*o,d.Q.value=.8;let f=n.createGain();f.gain.setValueAtTime(.12*r,a),f.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1e-4,a+.015),u.connect(d).connect(f).connect(s),c.start(a),c.stop(a+.08),u.start(a),c.onended=()=>s.disconnect()}
